generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)

Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily executed as a prime contractor, at least one similar work in any thermal power plant or cement industry or sugar industry or any process industry in Providing and fixing of heavy-duty rubber speed breakers, fabrication of movable and foldable MS Barricades, safety jacket mesh, traffic cone, safety net and Convex Mirrors for an amount of value not less than Rs 18.6 Lakhs in any of the preceding FIVE years. As a proof of this, the bidder should upload a single work order and corresponding work done certificate issued by the Competent Authority.Work done value of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited.The intending bidder shall submit the work order and relevant work done certificate as documentary proof issued by the competent authority. On demand, the original shall be produced for verification.

The Bidder should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of 37.2 Lakhs in any two of the preceding FIVE financial years.The bidder shall furnish the Profit and Loss statement duly certified by chartered accountant as a documentary proof. On demand original shall be produced for verification.Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited

itemList.description:
Providing Fabricating Supplying and Painting overall size of 1800mm lengthx1200 mm height MS Barricade.The outer structural frame shall be made of 30 mm x30 mm MS square pipe of 16 gauge
thickness, fully welded to form a rigid rectangular
structure.The internal horizontal and vertical members, including base bracing and stiffeners,shall be constructed using 18 mm x18 mm MS square pipe of 16 gauge thickness, The central infill panel shall consist of a 1.0 mm thick mild steel sheet, securely welded to the frame, Each wheel shall have a
minimum load-bearing capacity of 100 kg, ensuring durability and stability during operation. All welding joints shall be ground smooth, and all sharp edges and burrs shall be removed to ensure safe handling.followed by the application of one coat of red oxide or zinc chromate primer. Finishing shall be done with two coats of Asian enamel paint in yellow color, With Customizable Sticker at the center.

48 inch diameter,lens 1MM, polycarbonate sheet (unbreakable) Road Safety Convex mirror mounted on mild
steel circular pipe 65NB, 3mm thickness firmly fixed
to the ground by means of properly designed
foundation with M15 grade cement concrete 30cm X
30cm X 45cm, ground level as per approved drawing

Providing and fixing heavy duty rubber speed breaker
of 75 mm height, made from Rubber, suitable for
heavy vehicular traffic, finished in yellow and black
colour with reflective CAT eye markers. Each unit
shall be of size 500 mm X 400 mm X 75 mm, weighing approximately 18 kg per running meter, and
designed to withstand a load of 70 MT. Fixing shall be
done by drilling and anchoring with 10 mm MS bolts,
complete as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge

safety jacket mesh 70FSM fabtic 2" PVC tape-Green colour
